evidence.finding: Early-stage Electron desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux. Independent sidecar PTYs, local files, editable Markdown/code tiles and local JSON state. No account required; PostHog anonymous usage analytics.

evidence.title: LICENSE.md
evidence.finding: Application uses Functional Source License 1.1 with Apache-2.0 future license. Competing commercial uses are restricted before the future-license conversion.

evidence.title: Collaborator 0.8.4
evidence.finding: Collaborator 0.8.4 was published 2026-06-16. Release notes describe the scoped changes; this is not a hands-on check.

evidence.finding: Collaborator is a desktop app that works on local files with no account required; no price is stated.

evidence.locator: FSL-1.1-ALv2, License Grant and Permitted Purpose
evidence.finding: The Functional Source License allows use for any purpose except a Competing Use, converting to Apache-2.0 later; it does not state a price.

evidence.finding: collaborator.bot redirects to a 'Collab' page in closed beta with an early-access sign-up and no pricing.

evidence.finding: Desktop builds for macOS, Windows and Linux download from GitHub releases or a shell install script; the app works on local files with no account required. No price or paid plan is named.
